description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role

Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Director of Planning Systems to join our Strategic Finance organization. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will build and lead the team that owns the company's consolidated planning and reporting architecture, setting the strategy for how inputs from across the FP&A pillars flow into a coherent, system-based corporate view that informs decisions made by senior leadership, the executive team, and the Board.

This is a leadership role for someone who pairs strong financial and business acumen with a track record of leading finance transformation and planning systems at scale. You will define the multi-year finance systems vision, own the platform and its roadmap, and build a team spanning planning systems, consolidation, and executive reporting. You will act as a force multiplier for the broader FP&A organization and a trusted partner to Finance leadership. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment, gets energy from building durable infrastructure, and can stay close enough to the detail to hold the bar on accuracy.

You Will

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of 1–2 analysts to lead finance transformation efforts across finance and accounting, spanning planning systems, consolidation, and executive reporting, setting clear priorities and a high bar for accuracy and timeliness

  • Own the consolidated planning and reporting engine behind the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and monthly/quarterly forecast cycles, covering data intake, consolidation, and on-time delivery of the outputs reviewed by senior leadership, and lead its evolution into a scalable, system-based architecture

  • Serve as the functional and technical owner of the financial planning platform, leading EPM tool evaluation and selection, design, implementation, enhancement, administration, and team enablement

  • Own the planning systems roadmap end-to-end, including prioritization, sequencing against the planning calendar, governance, and change management, and communicate progress and trade-offs to Finance leadership

  • Design data flows and integrations connecting the planning platform to the ERP, data warehouse, and BI stack, partnering with Accounting, Data Engineering, Data Science and Analytics on architecture and data ownership

  • Support executive-facing financial deliverables, including the Weekly Business Review, monthly OpEx review, and quarterly Board and Audit Committee materials, and build dashboards and reporting that surface KPIs and business insights with minimal manual assembly

  • Partner with category, marketing, and ops finance leads to standardize how their inputs are gathered, pressure-tested, and consolidated into a single corporate view

  • Establish and enforce best practices across systems controls, data governance, and planning process documentation

You Have

  • B.S. in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or equivalent experience; MBA or CPA a plus

  • 12+ years of progressive experience spanning strategic finance / FP&A and finance systems or finance transformation roles, including 4+ years building and leading teams, ideally including managers

  • Strong financial and business acumen, including command of P&L mechanics, budgeting, forecasting, and the consolidation mechanics behind a company-wide planning cycle

  • Deep experience owning an EPM / planning platform (Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive, Planful, or similar) at the strategy level, including leading at least one full selection and implementation from business case through adoption

  • Demonstrated success leading multiple finance transformation initiatives end-to-end, standing up or materially scaling planning systems and automated reporting across a complex, multi-business organization

  • Experience managing vendor relationships, implementation partners, and a systems budget

  • Ability to translate large, complex datasets into clear, structured, decision-ready outputs for the executive team and Board

  • Proven ability to drive alignment and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and executive presence, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences, from system administrators to the executive team and Board

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments

  • Track record of leveraging AI and automation to improve finance workflows at a team or organizational level

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with SQL and experience with BI tools (Looker); NetSuite or similar ERP integration experience

  • Experience at a high-growth public company (recent IPO) or late-stage startup (Series C+) that has scaled through significant revenue and organizational growth

  • Direct experience supporting a public company's external reporting cycle (Board, Audit Committee, earnings/guidance)

  • Experience with SOX controls as they apply to planning and reporting systems

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
